_comment: Edit this file to change the case. Lengths in metres unless the key says _mm.

axes._comment: Model axes from the STL: nose points +Y, up is +Z, span is X.

reference._comment: Fixed values (estimated from the clean geometry) shared with ../cfd_pod so coefficients compare 1:1.

mesh._comment: Ansys Student caps Fluent at ~1M cells/nodes; these settings aim for ~0.6-0.9M.

solver._comment: iterations = max per angle; stops early once CL and CD change < force_tolerance over check_every iterations. ~5 s/iteration on 4 cores.
